prose: Respan (YC W24) launches an open-source AI gateway in Rust where everything is a plugin: providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), protocols (chat, realtime voice, MCP), modalities, and gateway features like fallbacks, PII redaction, and smart routing. The origin story is LiteLLM fatigue: after building a gateway on LiteLLM since 2024 that serves thousands of orgs, their wrapper code exceeded 100,000 lines, and a routine upgrade in January caused intermittent connection errors they never diagnosed, leaving them backporting fixes by hand. Inspired by Nginx, the redesign keeps a tiny core that only dispatches events, so teams assemble their own AI infrastructure without forking the gateway.
highlights: Open-source Rust AI gateway, YC W24
Everything is a plugin: providers, protocols, modalities, features
Small Nginx-inspired core that only dispatches events
Features as plugins: fallbacks, PII redaction, smart routing
Motivation: a 100k+ line LiteLLM wrapper and an undiagnosed upgrade regression
Gateway serves thousands of orgs today
